chapter_title: Concerning the Body: It was constructed after the
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Correspondence of the Mind with the Grand Human

---

**¶2:** The whole of the spiritual world, from its highest celestial degree to its lowest natural plane, reflects the form of the human mind; as the constitution of this external natural person accords to the form of the entire spiritual world.

**¶3:** Its inmost rational faculty is like the primary essences of the five external truths that clothe the spirit. From the conjunction of interior and exterior states down to the seat of the will, it mirrors the ten degrees of heavenly order. The will itself accords to the perpetually turning cycle of love's activity. From the will downward to the functions of spiritual appropriation, it mirrors the intermediate states extending from the cycle of the will down to the natural mind. The [GAP-1] generative intellectual faculty corresponds to the foundational natural mind. And from spiritual appropriation down to the powers of generation mirrors the three degrees of natural understanding. The structural supports of the lowest natural plane correspond to the space in which the sustaining foundational power stands. The very base corresponds to the great natural foundation upon which that sustaining power rests, and the four anchoring bonds beneath it. The organ of interior purification corresponds to the containing form of love. The selfhood corresponds to the containing form of falsity from evil. The life of faith corresponds to the containing form of truth.

**¶4:** This is how the individual mind corresponds to the Grand Human — in its degrees of order, its arrangements of states, its elevated states of love, its protective truths, and its containing forms, as I have made clear to you.

**¶5:** Once more I reveal to you: there exist five great governing states in the outermost region of the spiritual world, over which the five divine faculties proceeding from the Living Spirit hold dominion.

**¶6:** In the first and highest state of spiritual vigilance, over which the Guardian of Celestial Wisdom has dominion — upon the defensive perimeter of all good works — his authority extends over the three degrees of celestial life. Then those beneath him [GAP-2] the great Sovereign of Heavenly Honor.

**¶7:** The second state of vigilance, over which the great Sovereign of Heavenly Honor has dominion: his own authority extends over the seven degrees of spiritual arrangement beneath him.

**¶8:** The third state of vigilance, over which the Unyielding Divine Power [GAP-3] has dominion, whose authority reigns from the degree of spiritual order down to the [GAP-4] natural mind. [GAP-5] It quickens, according to its authority, the cycle of the will and the intermediate spiritual states, and the other four states that are appointed within the natural mind.

**¶9:** The fourth state of vigilance, over which the Sovereign of Divine Glory has power, encompasses the three turning cycles. His authority extends over the three degrees of natural understanding resting upon the sustaining foundational power.

**¶10:** The fifth state of vigilance is that over which the sustaining foundational power holds authority. It governs, according to its dominion, the great natural foundation upon which it stands, and the four anchoring bonds beneath it.

**¶11:** Spiritual temptation has arisen in these five states of vigilance from age to age.

**¶12:** In the state governed by the Guardian of Celestial Wisdom, evil desire sought to rise up and assault the visible form of the Divine Truth. Yet it was repelled from that place, and it fell back in humiliation.

**¶13:** Again, a fundamental disruption and betrayal of order occurred in the state governed by the great Sovereign of Heavenly Honor, which the guardian truths that had arisen at that time and had [GAP-6] — those who were sent descended, until they were subdued.

**¶14:** Also, in the state governed by the Unyielding Divine Power, monstrous falsities came down into the natural mind and fashioned [GAP-7] the form of the external selfhood.

**¶15:** Again, in the state governed by the Sovereign of Divine Glory, a disturbance arose in the three degrees of natural understanding above the sustaining foundation. The pathway of ascent was obstructed for the three turning cycles: that of thought, that of truth, and that of love.

**¶16:** Also, in the state governed by the sustaining foundational power, the anchoring bonds at the lowest level were exposed and their restraints upon evil strained to breaking. A great spiritual upheaval struck that place.

---

**¶25:** Once more, understand this other truth: there exist four levels within the external natural mind, and there exist innumerable governing affections within the mind's four levels, seven times multiplied.

**¶26:** The first level extends from the conjunction of interior and exterior upward to the inmost; and the seven governing faculties in this highest level are these: the two powers of intellectual understanding, the two powers of obedient perception, and the two powers of interior discernment. The remaining one is the faculty of appropriation, which is the power of discerning spiritual quality.

**¶27:** The second level extends from the conjunction of interior and exterior downward through the entire interior region. The seven governing faculties in this second level are: its two powers of action, which accord to the pattern of its two faculties of perception in the first level above; its two faculties of spiritual nourishment, which follow the pattern of its faculties of interior discernment; the two interior eyes of the will; and the faculty of initial reception between the two nurturing powers, which in the interior region mirrors the faculty of appropriation.

**¶28:** Once more, there exist seven governing principles in the third level of the mind, which are these: the abundance of good, the faculty of spiritual respiration, the power of interior cleansing, the purifying function of love, the faculty of zealous discrimination, and its two powers of examining and testing truths.

**¶29:** Also in the fourth and lowest level: there are another seven of this same kind — its two supporting powers, its two generative faculties, its two foundational strengths; and the faculty from which interior truths issue forth, begetting all forms of understanding.

---

**¶31:** The twelve fundamental states of spiritual knowledge that exist in the heavenly cycles above, upon the turning wheel of providence — they are interlocked and bound upon this revolving cycle, the one in which they are [GAP-8] established, confirmed, and implanted. Regarding all twelve of these spiritual states, this is how they were appointed and made to govern [GAP-9] upon the cycle beneath the heaven of ordered knowledges. They are arranged in this way so that one may find the beginning of [GAP-10] and one may find the ending as well [GAP-11].

**¶32:** Again, these states that we have enumerated exist one after another within the mind. They are counted by degree and order from the inmost to the outermost. The inmost rational faculty is the first state. The conjunction of interior with exterior and the power of sustaining strength is the second. The twin powers of action are the third. The encompassing interior protection is the fourth. The dominant love is the fifth. The state of natural receptivity and purity is the sixth. The central supporting structure, the faculty of balanced judgment and its processes of appropriation, are the seventh. The generative power with its inherent peril is the eighth. The directed foundational purpose is the ninth. The faculty of humility and submission is the tenth. The structural supports of the lowest plane are the eleventh. The very base of the natural is the twelfth.

**¶33:** Behold, these are also distributed one after another. They exist within the mind as if turned to the side and curved according to the pattern of the twelve states of spiritual knowledge. They too are thus arranged one against another, beginning to ending, as they appear upon the turning cycle [GAP-12] upward.

**¶34:** They are also counted by degree and order of the mind and all its faculties. We have proclaimed that these are turned, curved, and spread out; because from the inmost down to the center one may count six upon its volitional side, and another six upon its intellectual side.

**¶35:** The six upon the volitional side are these that I will recount: the volitional aspect of the inmost is the first state; its volitional power of sustaining strength is the second; its volitional power of action is the third; its volitional interior region is the fourth; its dominant love is the fifth; the volitional aspect of the generative faculty is the sixth.

**¶36:** Conversely, the other six of which we have spoken, upon the intellectual side — in contrast they proceed from the center back to the inmost: the intellectual [GAP-13] faculty of balanced judgment is the seventh; the intellectual interior region is the eighth; the intellectual faculty of nourishment and the intellectual power of examining truths is the ninth; its [GAP-14] intellectual power of action is the tenth; its intellectual sustaining strength is the eleventh; the intellectual aspect of the inmost is the twelfth. This is how the one who forms the mind has appointed them. He has [GAP-15] set them in order and arranged them, one against its companion, beginning to ending.

---

**¶38:** Hear this further teaching that I will proclaim to you. Understand that there exist innumerable powers within the external natural mind. They are the indwelling affections made to govern within it. There are affections beyond counting established as ruling principles in the human mind. They are distributed and made firm, apportioned according to their containing states. The count and number of their containing states is vast beyond reckoning.

**¶39:** When all these ruling affections come stirring and moving within the mind, they encounter one another; and they assail and overwhelm one another, and [GAP-16] within. When [GAP-17] they erupt from the mind of the person who [GAP-18] is spiritually perishing — they produce loathsome corruptions and spiritual injuries and burning torments within the mind. Either they may have caused sickness in the person's interiors; or else they may come forth upon the person's exterior life. Those spiritual wounds must first be pressed and discharge their falsity, and empty out their corruption, until they are fully pressed [GAP-19] and the putrefaction is forced out from the wound. Afterward, those wounds close over; and the person is healed and obtains peace from the afflictions that had erupted upon them.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This whole universe, above and below, reflects the pattern of the human body; as the formation of this body of flesh accords to the pattern of the universe.

Its head is like the first-fruits of the five garments. And, from its neck down to the site of its heart, it resembles the pattern of the ten firmaments. And again, the heart accords to the wheel of the rotating sphere. And, from its heart down to its intestines (?), is like this atmosphere that extends from the sphere down to the earth. The [male] part of the body corresponds to this great earth. And also, from its intestines (?) down to its loins is like the three earths. And also, its shinbones to the pattern of the space in which the Porter stands. Its footsoles to the great earth upon which the Porter is stood; and the four fastenings that are under his feet. Its liver to the vessel of fire. Its flesh to the vessel of darkness. Its blood to the vessel of water.
Now, this is how the small body corresponds to the macro-cosmos in its firmaments, in its orderings, in its mountains, its walls and its vessels, as I have made clear to you!
Once more, I reveal to you: There exist five great camps in this great outer zone, of which the five sons of the Living Spirit are masters.

So, in the first watch-station above, of which the Keeper of Splendour is master, on the battlement of all the works, is found his authority over the three heavens. Then the ones below him [belong to the watch of] the great King of Honour.
The second watch, of which the great King of Honour is master, his own authority (extends) over the seven firmaments beneath him.

The third watch, of which the Adamant [is master, his authority] reigns from the firmament down below to the [earth]. [And he] invigorates, according to his authority, the sphere and the worlds of the atmosphere; and the other four worlds that are appointed on this earth.
The fourth watch, over which the King of Glory has power, is the three wheels. And his authority lies over the three earths upon the head of the Porter.
The fifth watch is the watch over which the Porter is authoritative. Again, he is master, according to his authority, over this great earth he stands upon, and the four fastenings under his feet.
Affliction has come about in these five watches from time to time.
So, in the watch of the Keeper of Splendour, Sin desired to spurt up towards the image of the Ambassador. Yet, they barred it from that place, and it fell back down in shame.

Again, an earthquake and treachery occurred in the watch of the great King of Honour, which the watchers who had arisen at the time and had [rebelled] they who were sent came down, until they were humbled.
Also, in the watch of the Adamant, the abortions came to the earth and fashioned [the] figure of flesh.

Again, in the watch of the King of Glory, a commotion happened in these three earths above the Porter. The pathway was obstructed for the ascent of these three wheels; that of wind, that of water, and that of fire.
Also, in the watch of the Porter, the fastenings beneath were laid bare and strained their chains. A great earthquake befell that place.
Once more, understand this other (truth): There exist four worlds in this body of the flesh, and there exist countless times seven rulers in the body of the four worlds!

So, the first world is from its neck up; and also the seven rulers who are in this upper world are these: the two organs of sight, and the two of hearing, and the two of smell. The other one is the mouth, which is the organ of taste.

The second world is from its neck down to its entire upper torso. And also, the seven rulers who are in this second world are: its two arms that accord to the pattern of its two ears, which occur in its first world above; and its two breasts that are to the pattern of its organs of smell; and the two eyes of its heart; and the gullet of the stomach between the two breasts, which in the chest is the pattern of the mouth.
Once more, there exist seven rulers in the third world of the body, which are these: the fat, the lung, the spleen, the liver, the gall, and its two kidneys.

Also, the fourth world below. There are another seven there of this same kind: its two buttocks (?), and its two testicles, and its two loins; and the member out of which the seed comes, that begets all the forms.

Aries and Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces; these are the twelve signs of the zodiac that occur in the worlds above, on the sphere. They are interlocked and bound on this turning wheel, the one in which they are [set], fixed, and planted. And, regarding all these twelve signs of the zodiac, this is how they were appointed and made leaders [and set] on the sphere beneath the heaven that is the wheel of the stars. Now, they are appointed like this, they are thus, so that you can find the head of [each one] and you find the tail too [at the head of its companion]

Again, they occur like this, these that we have recited, one after another in this body. They are counted by order and number from the head to the feet. Its head is Aries. Its neck and its shoulders are Taurus. Its two arms Gemini. Its upper torso is Cancer. Its stomach is Leo. Its belly is Virgo. The vertical spine and its intestines (?) are Libra. Its genitals Scorpio. Its loins are Sagittarius. Its knees are Capricorn. Its shinbones are Aquarius. The soles of its feet are Pisces.

Behold, these are also distributed one after another. They exist in this body, as if turned to the side and bent to the pattern of the twelve signs of the zodiac. They too are thus, arranged one against another, head to tail, as they occur on the wheel [from below] up.

Also, they are counted by order and number of the body and all its members. So, we have proclaimed that these are turned to the side, bent, and spread out; because from its head down to its hip shall count six to its left, and another six to its right.

The six that are down its right are these that I will recount: the right temple is Aries; its right shoulder is Taurus; its right arm is Gemini; its right rib-cage is Cancer; its stomach is Leo; the right side of its reproductive organs are Virgo.

Conversely, the other six about which we have spoken, which are to its left, in contrast they come from its hip to its head: its left [hip] is Libra; its left rib-cage is Scorpio; its left breast and left kidney is Sagittarius; its [left] elbow is Capricorn; its left shoulder is Aquarius; its left temple is Pisces. This is how the creator of the body himself has appointed them. He has [set] them in order and arranged them, one against its companion, head to tail.

Listen to this other lesson that I will proclaim to you. Understand that there exist many powers in this body. They are the house-dwellers who are made the leaders in it. There are eight hundred and forty times ten thousand rulers made chiefs in the human body! They are distributed and set firm, quartered according to house. The count and number of their houses is two hundred and ten times ten thousand.

When all these rulers come creeping and moving within the body, they will meet one another; and they shall beset and destroy one another, and [fester] in them there. When [the sickness becomes great within them, then at last] they shall erupt from the body of the person who [will] die; and make putrid boils and sores and burning wounds in the body. Either they might have made him sick within; or else they might come forth upon his outer side. Those wounds shall first be squeezed and discharge their liquid, and empty out their pus, until they are squeezed [and emptied of all their corruption] and the suppuration forced out from the wound. Afterwards, their scars shall close over; and they are healed and obtain relief from the places that came out upon them.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading identifies this as the "generative intellectual faculty" corresponding to the "foundational natural mind," and the male generative organ is the natural-plane body part that corresponds to generative function; the editor's choice is correct.

The hierarchical structure requires a phrase connecting those below the Keeper of Splendour to the King of Honour's domain; "belong to the watch of" uses the chapter's own central term "watch" and establishes the jurisdictional transition between the first and second watch-stations.
The formulaic pattern of all five watch-stations uses "of which [title] is master" and then describes "his authority" extending over a domain; this exactly matches ¶6 and ¶7.

The spiritual reading identifies this as the "natural mind," whose consistent natural-plane correspondent throughout the chapter is "earth"; the Adamant's authority extends from the firmament down to the earth.

The spiritual reading shows "It quickens, according to its authority," continuing the subject of the Adamant; "And he" connects this clause to the preceding description of the Adamant's domain, matching the editor's reading.

The Watchers in the Manichaean-Enochic substrate are heavenly beings who transgressed; the clause "had arisen at the time and had rebelled" completes their characterization before the corrective agents ("they who were sent") descend to humble them.
The spiritual reading shows "fashioned the form of the external selfhood," and in the Kephalaia's natural register this is "the figure of flesh"; the definite article is required before "figure."

The spiritual reading gives the triad "established, confirmed, and implanted"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, "set, fixed, and planted" forms a perfect parallel triad of concrete placement verbs.

The passage parallels GAP-8's triad of placement ("set, fixed, and planted"); "appointed and made leaders and set on the sphere" bridges the appointment language to the location, using the same verb of cosmic placement found throughout the chapter.

The passage describes the head-to-tail arrangement of the twelve zodiac signs on the wheel; "the head of each one" refers to the beginning of each sign, matching the spiritual reading's "the beginning of [each state]."

fills.fill: at the head of its companion
fills.explanation: The head-to-tail arrangement means each sign's tail meets the next sign's head; "companion" is the chapter's own term from ¶36 ("one against its companion, head to tail"), and this phrase completes the description of circular interlocking.

The zodiac signs are arranged sequentially on the wheel from lowest to highest; "from below up" describes the directional order of their arrangement, matching the text's pattern of counting "from the head to the feet" and vice versa.

In ¶34 "from its head down to its hip shall count six to its left" establishes the hip as the dividing point; the left-side sequence in ¶36 begins at this level, and Libra (balanced judgment/spine area in ¶32) corresponds to the hip on the left side.
The entire sequence in ¶36 consistently describes the left-side body parts (left hip, left rib-cage, left breast, left elbow, left shoulder, left temple), so "left" is confirmed.
The spiritual reading confirms "He has set them in order and arranged them," and the verb "set" naturally precedes "in order" in the Kephalaia's register of cosmic arrangement.

The progression from rulers fighting within the body to erupting as boils and wounds requires an intermediate stage of internal corruption; "fester" precisely bridges the assault imagery to the medical imagery of putrid boils that follows.

fills.fill: the sickness becomes great within them, then at last
fills.explanation: The medical progression requires a crisis point between internal festering and external eruption; the rulers multiply and fight until the accumulated corruption reaches a critical threshold, at which point they erupt as boils from the body of the dying person.

The spiritual reading says "the person who is spiritually perishing," and in the natural register the future-tense auxiliary "will" before "die" expresses the imminence of bodily death that corresponds to spiritual perishing.

fills.fill: and emptied of all their corruption
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading emphasizes "fully pressed," indicating thoroughness; the first squeezing "discharges liquid" and "empties pus," so the second and final squeezing must achieve complete emptying of corruption before the deepest suppuration is forced out and healing can begin.
